name: nag
description: Keeps an approved summary of your CLAUDE.md, rules and output style in front of Claude on every prompt and after compaction, and flags it when the sources change.

global_summary_path.title: Global summary path
global_summary_path.description: Where the approved global summary is stored. Point it into a dotfiles repo to version it. Don't put it in ~/.claude/rules/, or it loads twice.

max_chars.title: Summary length limit
max_chars.description: Maximum characters per summary. It's re-sent on every prompt, so keep it short.

include_local.title: Include CLAUDE.local.md
include_local.description: Summarise the uncommitted CLAUDE.local.md into the project summary, which is usually committed.
